about_the_game:
Travel back in time to where movie magic was born!

The year is 1920. The flicker of silent reels lights up the screen, orchestras play in the aisles, and a new art form is taking its first bold steps. In Dawn of Cinema, the first major DLC for Movies Tycoon, you’ll guide your studio through the formative decades of film history—from the silent era of the 1920s to the bold, experimental wave of the 1970s. Build your empire amid the glamour, grit, and groundbreaking innovation of a time when every movie was a new frontier. Develop legendary stars, craft iconic sets, and create era-defining films that echo through time.

What’s Included in Dawn of Cinema:

  • New Time Period

Experience five dynamic decades of movie-making, from silent films to technicolor classics. Watch your studio evolve through the golden era of cinema, with changing audience tastes, technologies, and trends.

  • 8 New Buildings

Build new iconic vintage facilities for you studio to operate in the earlier period.

  • 8 New Set Locations

Create timeless films with new sets like classic horror laboratory, WW2 trenches, western steam train or the martial arts dojo.

  • Over 50 New Clothing Options

Style your stars with period-authentic costumes across five decades—flapper dresses, trench coats, glam rock jackets, mod fashion, military uniforms, and red carpet classics.

Whether you're filming a noir detective drama, a screwball comedy, or a gritty Vietnam-era epic, Dawn of Cinema opens the vault to decades of inspiration.

name: Movies Tycoon: Dawn of Cinema
short_description: Relive the birth of Hollywood and redefine the silver screen in Dawn of Cinema, the first major expansion for Movies Tycoon. Take your studio back to where it all began—from the roaring 1920s to the revolutionary 1970s—and shape the history of cinema, one classic at a time.
